questiontext.text: What is the main role of a field in a Java class?

generalfeedback.text: Fields (instance variables) define the state of an object.

answer.text: To store the state (values) of an object.

feedback.text: Correct — fields are instance variables that define object state.
No — methods define behavior, not fields.
Incorrect — imports are separate from fields.
Class names come from the class declaration, not fields.

questiontext.text: What must always be true about a constructor in Java?

generalfeedback.text: Constructors must have the same name as the class and no return type.

answer.text: Its name must match the class name.

feedback.text: Correct — this is required by the language.

answer.text: It must always take at least one parameter.

feedback.text: No — constructors can be parameterless.

answer.text: It must always return an int.

feedback.text: Constructors don’t declare a return type.
Not true — constructors are often public.

questiontext.text: In a constructor, parameters are typically used for what purpose?

generalfeedback.text: Constructor parameters usually provide initial values for fields.

answer.text: To initialize the fields of the new object.

feedback.text: Correct — parameter values are stored into fields.
No — parameters supply data, not methods.
Packages are separate declarations.
Printing isn’t the main role of parameters.

questiontext.text: What does the statement balance = balance + amount; do?

generalfeedback.text: Right-hand side is evaluated and copied into the left-hand variable.

answer.text: Adds amount to the current value of balance.

feedback.text: Correct — evaluates RHS, stores result into LHS.
No — it updates an existing variable.
Not true — this just overwrites balance.
Incorrect — only adds.

questiontext.text: Which of these is the best choice for a variable name?

generalfeedback.text: Good names make code easier to read and maintain.

feedback.text: Correct — descriptive and clear.
Too cryptic to be good style.
Not meaningful or clear.
Single letters should be avoided except for loops.

questiontext.text: Which of these is a Java keyword?

generalfeedback.text: Keywords are reserved words such as class, public, and private.

feedback.text: Correct — class is a reserved word.
An identifier, not a keyword.
A variable name, not a keyword.
User-defined identifier, not reserved.
